title: Battle of Khakeekera
text: The Battle of Khakeekera was a naval battle that took place in March 1811 between the combined forces of Bahrain and Kuwait on one side, and those of the Emirate of Diriyah led by Rahmah ibn Jabir al-Jalhami, the pirate Arab ruler of Dammam and some villages in Qatar, on the other. The battle took place northwest of Qatar and ended with a Bahraini victory.
